items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Gabriel' only as part of the band name 'Alabama State Gabriel' (likely a mishearing of 'Alabama State Guard' or similar, but explicitly linked to Erskine Hawkins). The interviewee describes his relationship with 'Chuckles' and 'Erskine Hawkins', but provides no personal inte

ctx.x: So, now, we're coming to the '40's and I'm particularly interested in your relationship with Chuckles and how that was developing and what really happened to you two during the '40's.

Well, now, we were with the Alabama State Gabriel (unintelligible) wich was Erskine Hawkins -- and still is Erskine Hawkins. And we was in Baltimore, Maryland, the home of the Harlem allstar, Baby Lawrence, and Chuckles' girlfriend was going to visit him -- his fiance, I should say, and he had gotten me to agree to be the best man. Now, the rumor got out

that he was going to become a husband -- at last. So, everybody that was in the show -- they loved Chuckles, see. He was that way, kind of infectious on people. So, he wanted to involve the audience, you know, and they wanted everybody to know that he was going to become a husband, you see. And so now (unintelligible) back stage that got in on him, so they said, "Well, why don't we get a -- we'll ride out front of the theater in taxis and the bus -- you know, a well, charter a bus, and the bride and groom and the…
